turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail: toms/duties: - Canada: No tariffs or duties on orders shipping within Canada. - US: Prices include applicable tariffs or import fees, so you won’t be charged extra at checkout or when your package arrives. - Exception: Orders over $750 USD may be subject to U.S. CBP Import Duties, Taxes and Fees, payable by the customer to the delivery courier. - International (outside of North America): Import duties, taxes, and associated administrative fees are the customer’s responsibility (as the importer).
